queries.query: Chhatarpur Madhya Pradesh official cadastral parcel map GIS land records
queries.result: Found the official Chhatarpur district land-records page. It states that spatial and non-spatial land-record data for 1,210 villages is public through MP Bhulekh, and identifies the Tehsildar Chhatarpur office as the local service location. Also found the Government of India DILRMP Chhatarpur map-digitization status page.

queries.result: Found the official Hindi Chhatarpur district land-records page, which describes computerized spatial/non-spatial land records and Naksha services, and the Madhya Pradesh e-service page describing certified Naksha (cadastral map), Khasra, and B-1 services. The source pages identify the public MP Bhulekh workflow but do not expose a verified anonymous parcel GeoJSON response in this attempt.
